# optimizelycmssaas_content_type_binding (Resource)

A binding that maps one content type (and its properties) onto another, e.g. for external content sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmssaas_content_type_binding" "product_to_page" {
  key  = "ProductToPage"
  from = "Product"
  to   = optimizelycmssaas_content_type.article.key

  # Map key = the path the property binds to.
  property_mappings = {
    heading = { from = "name" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from` (String) Key of the content type bound from.
- `key` (String) Unique key. Cannot be changed.
- `to` (String) Key of the content type bound to.

### Optional

- `property_mappings` (Attributes Map) Property mappings. The map key is the path the property binds to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_mappings))

<a id="nestedatt--property_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `property_mappings`

Required:

- `from` (String) Path of the property on the source content type.

Optional:

- `binding` (String) Key of an existing binding to reuse for this property.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import optimizelycmssaas_content_type_binding.product_to_page ProductToPage
```
